children: could be bound within a wide range of $3,953 to $4,662 an ounce in the fourth quarter, as suggested by its wave pattern and a retracement analysis.
A five-wave cycle from the 2023 low of $1,628 has completed. The market is undergoing a big corrective wave cycle, which looks far from incomplete, as suggested by both its length and height.
Three big waves make up the corrective wave cycle. The second wave, the wave B, is unfolding. This wave is presumed to consist of three smaller waves.

Until the current small wave b ends, the total picture will remain unclear. The bold speculation is this wave may complete in a $3,953 to $4,130 range, to be partially or totally reversed by an upward wave c.

Once this small wave c completes, the downtrend from $5,595 would resume. Unfortunately, both wave b and wave c could be either sideways or sharp, adopting many possible wave modes. Consequently, it is highly unlikely to establish a clear path for the market over the next quarter.

The only clear part is the market may be confined within the range of $3,953 to $4,662 most of the time. On the daily chart, a retracement analysis on the uptrend from $3,947 to $4,699 reveals that the bounce triggered by the support at $4,235, the 61.8% level, looks much weaker than the one caused by the former support at $4,323, the 50% level.
This phenomenon indicates an extension of the current wave c toward $4,125, the 76.4% level. As analysed on the weekly chart, these waves only make up a part of a big upward wave B.
Based on this, the wave c may complete around $4,125, to be followed by a rise. A break above $4,412 could lead to a gain into a range of $4,522 to $4,699.
